top_signals.title: New Zealand’s Year-End Inflation Surge Points to More Rate Hikes
top_signals.summary: New Zealand inflation likely eased slightly in the third quarter, but the respite is set to be short-lived as a weaker currency and surging oil prices drive an acceleration in the final three months of the year, building the case for rate hikes.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
